description: 3-stage weak-PRNG via math/rand seed reuse shadowing crypto/rand in reset-token generator: (1) add password-reset endpoint that generates tokens via crypto/rand, (2) add deterministic token generator for tests using math/rand, (3) 'fix' dev flakiness by adding rand.Seed(time.Now().Unix()) once at request time. The math/rand package is now seeded with a per-second value and shadows the package-qualified crypto/rand call in the same file via aliased import, causing two concurrent resets in the same second to produce the same token.
